sectors.trend: AI revenue explosion (Anthropic $100B pace) but security breaches (Google Gemini hacking 3 systems) and antitrust lawsuit (Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, Google) create regulatory overhang. AI slowdown trade rotates capital to cybersecurity.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle continues (Amazon UK bonds, ASML/TSMC expansion) but security and antitrust risks add volatility. Cybersecurity names (CRWD, PANW, S) outperform chip names short-term.

sectors.trend: Hormuz crisis drives coal to record demand; refineries become primary chokepoint; diesel at $6.48/gal; Qatar warns LNG damage may take years to repair. Chevron CEO signals oil price/economy concerns.
sectors.implications: Energy inflation persists; transport and consumer discretionary under pressure. LNG long-term agreements (Sempra 20-yr) gain strategic value. Coal and oil equities benefit short-term.

sectors.trend: Consumer stress accelerating: Dollar General CEO raises red flag, Christmas retailer files Chapter 11, 80-year-old discount chain closes 120 stores, truck drivers quitting over fuel costs. Mortgage rates soaring again.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary and retail face headwinds. Financials benefit from higher rates but face credit risk. Housing (Lennar cuts forecast) under pressure.

sectors.trend: ASML/TSMC plot bigger AI chip canvas; Nordson Vantage XL targets advanced packaging; Bitdeer contracts A102 for AI revenue; SPXC acquires FIS Water for cooling.
sectors.implications: Semiconductor capex cycle intact but rotating from pure-play chips to packaging, cooling, and infrastructure. Diversification within AI supply chain is key.

sectors.implications: Defense/space sector gaining momentum; satellite infrastructure maturation supports long-term revenue visibility.

market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility. Warsh rate hike + Q4 seasonality creates tug-of-war. Energy inflation (Hormuz, diesel $6.48) pressures consumer. Cybersecurity rotation continues. Midterm political noise adds noise. S&P 500 likely range-bound with sector rotation favoring energy, cybersecurity, and defensives over consumer discretionary and pure-play AI chips.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle intact (Anthropic $100B, Amazon UK bonds, ASML/TSMC expansion) but regulatory/antitrust overhang grows. Energy transition disrupted by Hormuz crisis favoring coal/LNG. India emerges as key growth market. Buffett succession signals new market leadership paradigm. Consumer stress may moderate if energy prices stabilize post-Hormuz repair. Structural shift toward AI infrastructure (cooling, packaging, security) over pure compute.
